supersedes.reason: Gate C adds the planned Windows desktop viewport stack: local ketchup-interaction and ketchup-app packages plus pinned eframe 0.32.3, egui 0.32.3, and wgpu 25.0.2 dependencies. The license allowlist adds only BSL-1.0, CC0-1.0, OFL-1.1, and Ubuntu-font-1.0 after cargo-deny identified those permissive/free transitive inputs and before any replacement A0 or Gate C observation. No threshold, corpus, expected outcome, hardware profile, oracle, or consequence changes.

inherited_contract: All thresholds, corpora, expected outcomes, hardware profiles, oracles, consequences, toolchain evidence, and OCCT inputs are inherited byte-for-byte from r0-v6. Cargo.lock records the Gate C GUI/renderer stack and deny.toml explicitly allows its four audited permissive/free licenses.
immutability_rule: Any listed byte change after an A0 or Gate C observation fails the r0-v7 run. A replacement requires a new freeze_id and report; historical evidence remains unchanged.
